indexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX analyses_owner_created_at ON falcon_mesh.analyses USING btree (owner_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX analyses_owner_id_request_id_key ON falcon_mesh.analyses USING btree (owner_id, request_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX analyses_pkey ON falcon_mesh.analyses USING btree (owner_id, id)
CREATE INDEX lending_events_intent_created ON falcon_mesh.lending_events USING btree (owner_id, intent_id, created_at, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX lending_events_one_submission ON falcon_mesh.lending_events USING btree (owner_id, intent_id) WHERE (kind = 'SUBMITTED'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX lending_events_owner_id_request_id_key ON falcon_mesh.lending_events USING btree (owner_id, request_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX lending_events_pkey ON falcon_mesh.lending_events USING btree (owner_id, id)
CREATE INDEX lending_intents_owner_created ON falcon_mesh.lending_intents USING btree (owner_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX lending_intents_owner_id_request_id_key ON falcon_mesh.lending_intents USING btree (owner_id, request_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX lending_intents_pkey ON falcon_mesh.lending_intents USING btree (owner_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX source_heads_pkey ON falcon_mesh.source_heads USING btree (owner_id, source_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX source_revisions_owner_id_source_key_revision_id_key ON falcon_mesh.source_revisions USING btree (owner_id, source_key, revision_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX source_revisions_pkey ON falcon_mesh.source_revisions USING btree (owner_id, revision_id)

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, intent_id) REFERENCES falcon_mesh.lending_intents(owner_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, analysis_id) REFERENCES falcon_mesh.analyses(owner_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, source_key, revision_id) REFERENCES falcon_mesh.source_revisions(owner_id, source_key, revision_id)
